points.description: States that cleaning is done by scraping (removing/cutting off) the top layer of the filter medium/sand (Schmutzdecke, about 1-2 cm).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says cleaning by removing dirty layer vaguely, or mentions only cleaning/scraping without the medium or top layer.

points.description: States that the removed/scraped sand is then washed (and may be reused).
points.partial_credit: Half if washing is mentioned vaguely without clear link to the scraped medium.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying the top layer of sand/Schmutzdecke is scraped off and then washed, in any wording. Give 1 mark if only scraping (or only washing) is stated. Exact depth (1-2 cm) and the term Schmutzdecke are not needed; give 0 for backwashing or unrelated methods alone.
